panels.title: Alert share by rule (3h)
panels.description: One rule dominating is the classic sign of a threshold set too low.

panels.title: Alerts deduplicated (3h)
panels.description: Repeat firings folded into existing alerts. High is good — it is the noise you are not seeing.

targets.rawSql: select last_detected_at as "last seen", severity, rule_id as rule, entity_type || ':' || entity_id as entity, occurrences, observed, threshold, triage from detections.alerts where active order by last_detected_at desc limit 50

panels.title: Highest risk entities
panels.description: Scores here are as stored; decay is applied when read through the API.

targets.rawSql: select entity_type as type, entity_id as entity, round(score, 1) as score, round(peak_score, 1) as peak, updated_at as "last alert" from detections.risk_scores where score > 0 order by score desc limit 25

panels.title: Rule quality — precision against analyst verdicts
panels.description: Precision is only meaningful once alerts have been triaged. Untriaged alerts are the work not yet done.

targets.rawSql: select rule_id as rule, count(*) as alerts, sum(occurrences) as firings, count(*) filter (where triage = 'true_positive') as tp, count(*) filter (where triage = 'false_positive') as fp, count(*) filter (where triage = 'untriaged') as untriaged, round(count(*) filter (where triage = 'true_positive')::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where triage in ('true_positive','false_positive')), 0), 3) as precision from detections.alerts group by rule_id order by alerts desc

panels.title: Response actions
panels.description: Anything sitting in 'proposed' is waiting for a human. That is the system working.

targets.rawSql: select proposed_at as proposed, action, target_type || ':' || target_id as target, status, requires_approval as "needs approval", approved_by, coalesce(error, result) as outcome from detections.response_actions order by proposed_at desc limit 50
select at, actor, action, subject_type || ':' || subject_id as subject, outcome, detail::text from detections.audit_log order by at desc limit 100
